entries.speaker: Makoto
entries.en: ...What is that supposed to be?

entries.speaker: Futaba
entries.en: Don't worry about it.

entries.speaker: Yusuke
entries.en: Such avant garde design. You have[n]excellent taste.

entries.speaker: Futaba
entries.en: ...Mwehehe.

entries.speaker: Makoto
entries.en: L-Let's get started, shall we?

entries.speaker: Morgana
entries.en: What do you plan on doing?

entries.speaker: Makoto
entries.en: I'd like to simply have a normal[n]conversation. That is the basis of[n]true communication, after all.
You seem confident.
Will that be enough?

entries.speaker: Makoto
entries.en: Yes. You must be well-versed in speaking[n]when you are student council president.

entries.speaker: Makoto
entries.en: I thought it would be best to start off just[n]by learning some more about each other.

entries.speaker: Makoto
entries.en: Don't think too hard about our[n]conversation. We're just going to[n]talk about ordinary topics today.

entries.speaker: Yusuke
entries.en: And what do you mean by ordinary[n]topics?

entries.speaker: Makoto
entries.en: You know, things like food or the[n]weather.

entries.speaker: Makoto
entries.en: Well then, let's begin with food. What do[n]you like to eat, Futaba?

entries.speaker: Futaba
entries.en: Organic ones.

entries.speaker: Makoto
entries.en: Um, that wasn't exactly what I meant...

entries.speaker: Makoto
entries.en: L-Let's try a different topic! How about[n]the weather?

entries.speaker: Makoto
entries.en: I heard that this heat wave is showing no[n]sign of stopping...

entries.speaker: Futaba
entries.en: Dunno. I haven't been out.

entries.speaker: Makoto
entries.en: O-Oh, right...

entries.speaker: Morgana
entries.en: Makoto's getting overwhelmed...

entries.speaker: Makoto
entries.en: Th-This is odd... It wasn't supposed to go[n]like this...

entries.speaker: Makoto
entries.en: By the way Yusuke, what have you been[n]doing this whole time?

entries.speaker: Yusuke
entries.en: ...Ah, superb.

entries.speaker: Yusuke
entries.en: Some of their heads came off when I was[n]moving them, but I made sure to[n]rearrange them pleasingly.

entries.speaker: Futaba
entries.en: W-Waaaaaaaah!

entries.speaker: Futaba
entries.en: M-My children... Wh-What have you[n]done... to my children?

entries.speaker: Yusuke
entries.en: They appear to be quite shoddily-made.

entries.speaker: Futaba
entries.en: They're from "Phoenix Rangers Neo[n]Featherman"!

entries.speaker: Futaba
entries.en: No... Yellow and Pink's heads... And Red's[n]been hacked to bits... This is all Inari's[n]fault...

entries.speaker: Yusuke
entries.en: Inari?

entries.speaker: Futaba
entries.en: You know, inari sushi? The tofu things[n]foxes eat in the old stories? What kind[n]of Fox doesn't know that?

entries.speaker: Yusuke
entries.en: Inari...

entries.speaker: Futaba
entries.en: Rghhh, they were in the perfect poses too![n]It was so much work getting them set up[n]just right!

entries.speaker: Futaba
entries.en: You wouldn't know aesthetics if it hit you[n]in the face, Inari!

entries.speaker: Yusuke
entries.en: H-How dare you say that to me of all[n]people!?

entries.speaker: Morgana
entries.en: Sheesh, that's not a conversation[n]anymore... It's a full-blown argument.

entries.speaker: Makoto
entries.en: Yeah...

entries.speaker: Yusuke
entries.en: I see... So their versatility allows you to[n]recreate almost any dramatic scene[n]you can imagine.

entries.speaker: Futaba
entries.en: Mm-hm. Victory is great for action, and[n]Neo's got the best transforming suit.[n]So cool.

entries.speaker: Yusuke
entries.en: Fascinating. Art depicts a flash of[n]inspiration, but models offer a much[n]different means of enjoyment.

entries.speaker: Morgana
entries.en: Huh? Take a look at that—Futaba's having[n]a regular conversation.

entries.speaker: Makoto
entries.en: It seems she doesn't have a problem[n]talking to others as long as the subject[n]interests her.

entries.speaker: Makoto
entries.en: I suppose the topics I brought up were[n]not the right ones.

entries.speaker: Futaba
entries.en: So this is all I gotta do? What a breeze!

entries.speaker: Yusuke
entries.en: In that case, we should advance to the[n]next step.

entries.speaker: Yusuke
entries.en: How about we have her spend time in[n]someone else's room?

entries.speaker: Makoto
entries.en: Yes. She hasn't had many chances to[n]leave the house yet, so that would be[n]the perfect opportunity.

entries.speaker: Futaba
entries.en: Don't set the bar so high!
Don't worry.
We'll all be there too.
Just give it a try.

entries.speaker: Futaba
entries.en: Hrrrgh... Okay...

entries.speaker: Futaba
entries.en: W-Well, I guess in that case...

entries.speaker: Futaba
entries.en: Rrrggh... I can't stand this gung-ho way[n]of doing things...

entries.speaker: Makoto
entries.en: I've left tomorrow to Ann and Ryuji.[n][fName] will be there as well,[n]so you'll be okay.

entries.speaker: Futaba
entries.en: Can I wear my mask?

entries.speaker: Makoto
entries.en: I-I think it would be best if you didn't...

entries.speaker: Morgana
entries.en: There's really no telling how tomorrow's[n]going to go...
